parsed.reason: The watch shows a plain black lacquered dial with a date window at 5 and a seconds track on the bezel, in a white-metal case on a black alligator strap. This matches the Code 11.59 Selfwinding 41mm 15210 family, but the black dial is not obviously the blue, sodalite, red or malachite dial of the listed variants, and the closest listed match would be the 15210BC.OO.A002KB.01 or .02, which differ only subtly.
